input.summary: Make Vendor a non-exclusive provider, removing the sole-supplier commitment on Customer
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot commit to a sole-supplier arrangement, so we have made Vendor a non-exclusive provider; this also removes the conflict with Sections 2.1 and 12.3, which confirm we have given no exclusivity or minimum-volume commitment.

ops.oldText: 2.2 Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
ops.newText: 2.2 Vendor will be a non-exclusive provider of hosted analytics services, and Customer may procure the same or similar services from any third party at any time.
